records.subject: Haven't seen you in Wrenfield lately
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Noticed Quartz Collective hasn't gotten a project going in Wrenfield yet. If something got in the way, happy to help clear it -- even a 10-minute call can usually unstick it.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Quartz Collective!
records.body:
Hi Nora,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero reply to the welcome email [email:0b95e6c4]. No tickets or any engagement signal, so nothing suggests self-driven momentum in the remaining 8 days; Starter solo accounts that go silent this long rarely activate unaided.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Nora,

Checking in since you got started with Wrenfield last week. If it helps to know where to begin: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week be useful? I'm glad to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that's come up.

Best,
Nadia
